I’m honored to once again earn the endorsement of CBTU’s St. Louis Chapter.

CBTU has done incredible work advocating for the rights of Black workers in the St. Louis area for decades.

Together, we’re building a movement to fight for livable wages, fair working conditions, the right to organize, and more.
